## Design

### 2026-10-07 – October 6,7

**2.2h**

October 6,7

I started working on my Starbie, which i am calling a Moon boy.

October 6:

I designed the PCB schematic and got all the parts ready to put on a PCB. I have used kicad previously so this wasn't that bad. One thing i did learn was the use of labels which i had not used in previous projects.

October 7:
I started designing the PCB for Moon boy which is a crab like shape. I then routed all the wires to connect all the parts i am going to add. I had used vias in previous projects so i also used them in this one. To finish i added the half life symbol to my PCB.

### 2026-10-10 – October 9,10

**3h**

October 9,10

I finished designing the PCB for my Moon boy. I added three images to it which will be on the PCB. One is the half life logo, one is aggregate demand and the last is a picture for the C programming language.

I then open the code for the Starbie and edited it to suit my board, although i am sure i will need to change a few things once it arrives.

I designed the digital pet that will be on the Moon boy using a pixel rt maker online.

Finally i created the Gthub repo for my Moon boy and added all the files for it, while also finding the places to source the parts.

I hope that by the end of Half Life i can design my own PCB similar to this an make a similar gadget.
